campaign.name: Threads of Peace
campaign.tagline: When war ends, peace becomes a profession.
hook_paragraphs: Belavadös is no longer a continent ruled by open war. Harbor law, industrial guilds, civic roads, merchant courts, and sprawling trade hubs have transformed violence into something quieter: bureaucracy, corruption, debt, and carefully regulated power. The wars ended generations ago, but peace did not come freely. It is maintained through treaties, commerce, industrial expansion, and institutions so vast most people no longer question what they were built to protect.

In this new age, assassins have become relics of a bloodier era. The party are among the few who survived long enough to reinvent themselves, former killers now working as freelance peacekeepers wherever civilization begins to break down. Bronzewake, capital settlement of Virelport province, becomes their ideal starting point: a storm-worn city of customs houses, harbor law, smuggling rings, guild ledgers, and contracts that all touch something larger beneath the surface.

At first, the work seems practical enough. Expose a corrupt salvage syndicate in Shadewharf, Marrowynd. Protect exploited workers. Repair a storm shelter in Stormgullet, Virelport. Mediate between rival guilds in Veilstrand, Virelport. Investigate poisoned commerce in Straithaven, Virelport. Yet every job uncovers the same unsettling pattern: ancient ruins hidden beneath infrastructure, missing crews near excavation sites, impossible symbols buried inside sealed utility tunnels, and officials financing secret operations beneath cities that should never have been built where they stand.

The deeper the party travels into Belavadös, the clearer it becomes that the continent’s peace was never as stable as it appeared. Commercial networks mirror forgotten pathways. Industrial systems hum atop buried mechanisms no one fully understands. Entire institutions seem devoted not merely to maintaining order, but to holding something older at bay. And behind the polished faces of merchant houses, harbor courts, dragon-blooded dynasties, and public virtue, powers long thought dormant are beginning to stir again.
Some whisper that the old wars never truly ended. Only sealed.
premise_paragraphs: Belavadös exists in the uneasy aftermath of divine tyranny and continental war. Industrial guilds, harbor courts, trade houses, and regulated arcane authorities now maintain civilization through bureaucracy rather than open conquest. Yet beneath that fragile peace, the seals imprisoning the gods and primordial forces are beginning to fail.

The party, once assassins trained to destabilize nations, now work as freelance peacekeepers traveling the continent to solve problems too dangerous, political, or morally compromised for official authorities to touch.
Their contracts begin small: smuggling rings, labor exploitation, sabotage, corruption, disappearances, disasters, cult violence, and arcane contamination.
Over time, every job reveals the same terrifying truth: Belavadös’ peace was never stable. It was containment.

The campaign gradually shifts from grounded political intrigue and infrastructure-based adventures into continental cosmic horror centered around the awakening of Thoryn-Rahek, the weakening seals, and the emergence of the Soulbound prophecy.
campaign.campaign_shape: Former assassins reinvented as freelance peacekeepers; begins as street-level corruption and industrial intrigue, then escalates into continent-wide cosmic horror around failing divine seals and the Soulbound prophecy.

summary: An engine guild secretly harvests emotional resonance from passengers, patrons, and diplomatic guests to power arcane engines.

moral_choice: Destroy the system and collapse civic services.
Expose it and risk continent-wide panic.

events.title: The Dragon’s Bargain
summary: An ancient bronze dragon offers information regarding the seals in exchange for protection from industrial hunters.

the_dragon_confirms: The gods were imprisoned centuries ago.

events.title: Ashes Above Mostrerah
summary: Storm raiders attack during a volcanic lightning storm.
Afterward, a massive crimson sigil appears in the clouds over Iazethas.

events.title: Eldryssar Archives
events.core_theme: History was buried for a reason.
summary: The party investigates forbidden records inside Eldryssar.
events.correction_note: Old movement-system reference removed; Eldryssar is retained as the Vaelmyrith capital anchor.

events.title: The Promethean Vault
events.core_theme: History was buried for a reason.
summary: The party encounters autonomous constructs tied to Setrimir’s stolen divine fire.

events.title: Echoes of Previous Lives
events.core_theme: History was buried for a reason.
summary: One party member begins experiencing fragmented visions, foreign memories, and ancient battlefields.
The Soulbound influence quietly begins.

events.title: The Forgotten Colossus War
events.core_theme: History was buried for a reason.
summary: The party uncovers evidence that entire civilizations were erased during the original containment wars.

events.title: Refugee Shelters
summary: Refugee populations surge into emergency shelters and wetland camps.

events.title: The Cult Census
summary: The party tracks coordinated cult recruitment efforts across civic offices, mining towns, and industrial districts.

discovery: The cults are intentionally spreading despair and addiction to weaken the seals.

events.title: Blackfin Flood
summary: Dragon turtle attacks force the party into flooded ruins beneath tidal channels.
events.correction_note: Old movement-system label removed; Blacktide Reach is the current Marrowynd city anchor.

events.title: The Prophecy Fragment
summary: A hidden archive references: “Two brothers shall stand before the Final Seal.”

events.title: Arcane Weather
summary: Storm systems across Belavadös begin behaving unnaturally.

effects: Ghost manifestations in public stations and abandoned halls

events.title: The Wild Mage
summary: The party first encounters the younger brother during a catastrophic magical accident in Glattonica.
He saves civilians, but levels half a district.

events.title: The Elder Brother
summary: The elder brother hires the party briefly for protection during investigations into ancient ruins.
He is calm, disciplined, and exhausted.

events.title: Beneath Karag-Thûl
summary: The party discovers cultists excavating ancient machinery tied to the First Seal.
The elder brother instinctively recognizes symbols he should not know.

events.title: Rumors in the Foundations
events.corrected_location: Belavadös-wide, anchored from Belynthar to Moltharok

location_refs.raw: Belavadös-wide, anchored from Belynthar to Moltharok

summary: Aberrations begin appearing near abandoned tunnels and ruins across Belavadös.
The party repeatedly crosses paths with the brothers during containment operations.

events.title: Echoes of Previous Lives
summary: The elder brother’s visions worsen.
Historians in Belynthar identify Soulbound references connected to ancient reincarnations.
The party learns the brothers may be central to the prophecy.

events.title: The Hunt Beneath the World
summary: The party joins the brothers investigating disappearances beneath Moltharok.

catastrophe: The elder brother dies temporarily during battle with primordial horrors.
His soul descends into Nefarokir’s prison systems.

events.title: The Weakening of the First Seal
summary: After his resurrection, the elder brother returns changed, the First Seal weakens, and supernatural disturbances intensify continent-wide.
The party realizes the apocalypse may already be underway.

events.title: The Primordial Gift
summary: Melinoe approaches the younger brother.

events.title: Primordial Ichor
summary: The younger brother destroys an aberration near Lithvar using impossible levels of power.
The party investigates primordial ichor distribution networks.

events.title: Addiction and Isolation
summary: Violent magical episodes begin harming civilians.
The party attempts mediation between the brothers.
Melinoe quietly sabotages every effort.

events.title: The Shattered Brotherhood
events.corrected_location: Vaelunthir, Astraevos province; Eldryssar, Vaelmyrith province
summary: The elder brother researches Soulbound prophecies in Vaelunthir and Eldryssar.
The party discovers references to “Two Brothers Standing Before the Final Seal.”

events.title: Cults in the Shadows
summary: Cult activity erupts openly across Belavadös.

events: Rift creatures attack high towers and civic strongholds

events.title: Visions from the Prison
summary: The elder brother experiences direct visions from Raeshkul.

the_party_learns: Multiple containment systems are already collapsing

events.title: Toward Illyrion
events.corrected_location: Forgotten ruins near Illyrion (legacy site, current province unassigned)

location_refs.raw: Forgotten ruins near Illyrion (legacy site, current province unassigned)

summary: The party escorts both brothers toward the forgotten ruins near Illyrion.

pursuers: Massive unnatural storms engulf surrounding regions.

events.title: The Vault Beneath Creation
events.corrected_location: Deep beneath Illyrion (legacy site, current province unassigned)

location_refs.raw: Deep beneath Illyrion (legacy site, current province unassigned)

summary: Ancient war machines awaken.
Impossible architecture bends reality.
Lamia stands within a ritual chamber.
Melinoe convinces the younger brother that Lamia must die.
The party must choose whom to trust.

events.title: The Breaking Point
events.core_theme: Escort mission through the edge of apocalypse.
summary: Inside the vault, primordial magic destabilizes reality.
The younger brother loses control.
The elder brother realizes events were manipulated from the beginning.
The party barely escapes alive.

events.title: The Truth of Lamia
events.core_theme: Escort mission through the edge of apocalypse.
summary: The horrifying truth emerges: Lamia is the Final Seal.
Killing her awakens Thoryn-Rahek fully.
Melinoe serves the imprisoned Colossus.
The mission becomes a desperate race to keep the brothers alive long enough to stop total collapse.

events.title: Awakening Beneath the World
events.core_theme: Escort mission through the edge of apocalypse.
events.corrected_location: Belavadös-wide; collapse zones tied to Illyrion
summary: Belavadös descends into catastrophe.

continental_events: Coastal crews disappear beneath black tides.
The party protects the brothers through a continent actively unraveling.

events.title: The Soulbound Choice
events.core_theme: Escort mission through the edge of apocalypse.
summary: The elder brother fully awakens as the newest Soulbound incarnation.
Memories from countless past lives flood into him.
The younger brother struggles against primordial corruption.
Deep beneath reality, something ancient finally opens its eyes.
The campaign ends with the party facing the central question of Belavadös: will the brothers destroy one another, or stand together against the hunger beneath creation?
